scenarios.title: The conductor skill text and its hard stops come from the imported SKILL.md
scenarios.state: fresh browser context, no stored choices
steps: Open the entry URL at 1440x900.
Scroll to the section headed 'What it will not do' and read the numbered list.
Scroll to the section headed 'The skill'; read the first 12 lines of the large text block and note the 'View on GitHub' link target.

Compare the numbered list and the block's text with the file at /Users/berwinsingh/Documents/oldhand/skills/oldhand/SKILL.md (read it with your file tool): the list items must equal the '## Hard stops' items of that file, and the block must equal the whole file.
expect: The numbered list under 'What it will not do' has the same items, in the same order, as the '## Hard stops' section of skills/oldhand/SKILL.md.
The large text block under 'The skill' starts with the file's frontmatter ('---', 'name: oldhand') and ends with the file's last line.
'View on GitHub' links to https://github.com/berwinsingh/oldhand/blob/main/skills/oldhand/SKILL.md.
The Copy control next to it exists; after clicking it the control reads 'Copied'.

scenarios.title: Each install tab shows commands, a tested line and the line to type afterwards, and Copy copies the exact command
steps: Open the entry URL at 1440x900.
For each tab in the install switcher (Any agent, Claude Code plugin, Codex plugin, Git clone): click it, read every command block, the note, the 'Then, in ...' lines and the 'Tested ...' line.

On each tab, before clicking Copy, add a listener in the page: document.addEventListener('copy', e => { window.__copied = document.getSelection().toString(); }); then click the Copy control of the first command block and read window.__copied (the page falls back to a selection-based copy when the clipboard API is blocked). If window.__copied is empty, read navigator.clipboard.readText() instead.
Press the right arrow key while a tab has focus and note which tab becomes selected.
expect: Four tabs exist with those labels; exactly one is selected at a time (aria-selected=true).

Every tab shows at least one command block, a 'Tested 2026-10-11 ...' line naming a tool version, and at least one 'Then, in ...' line with a command starting with /oldhand, /oldhand:oldhand, $oldhand or 'Use the oldhand skill'.
The copied text (window.__copied or the clipboard) equals the command block's text exactly, including newlines for multi-line blocks, and the control reads 'Copied' afterwards.
The right arrow key moves the selection to the next tab.

scenarios.title: Readable in light and dark at 1440 and 375 with no horizontal scroll, no text under 13px, AA contrast
steps: Open the entry URL; set the viewport to 1440x900 with the light colour scheme, then dark; then the mobile preset (375 wide) light, then dark. Reset to desktop at the end.
At each of the four combinations run in the page: document.documentElement.scrollWidth and window.innerWidth; and collect every element whose own text node has a computed font-size below 13px.

At each combination read the computed colour and background of body text, of a link, and of the selected tab's text; compute the WCAG contrast ratio (relative luminance formula) for each pair against the page background.
Take a screenshot at each combination and save it under the evidence folder.
expect: scrollWidth equals innerWidth at every combination (no horizontal page scroll).
No element with visible text has a computed font-size below 13px.
Body text, links and the selected tab text each have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against the page background in both schemes.
The four screenshots show the same content with legible text.

scenarios.title: Analytics stay off until the footer toggle is used; the choice persists; no overlay
scenarios.state: fresh browser context (localStorage empty); verify with localStorage.getItem('oldhand-analytics-consent') === null first, clearing it if not
steps: Open the entry URL. Run in the page: !!document.querySelector('script[data-oldhand-analytics]') and list network requests whose URL contains googletagmanager.
Check that no element overlays the page: no fixed-position element besides the sticky header, and no element with text 'Allow analytics' or 'No thanks'.
Scroll to the footer; read the analytics sentence and click its button.
Run the same script and network checks again; read localStorage.getItem('oldhand-analytics-consent').
Reload the page; run the checks again.
Click the footer button again (it should now offer to turn analytics off); run the checks and read localStorage again.
expect: Before the click: no analytics script element, no googletagmanager request, no overlay, and the footer reads 'Google Analytics is off; nothing is sent.' with a 'Turn on Google Analytics' button and a 'How Google uses data' link.

After the click: a script element with data-oldhand-analytics exists, a request to www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-75YW6HE9FT was made, localStorage holds 'granted', and the footer reads 'Google Analytics is on.' with a 'Turn it off' button.
After reload the script element is present again without any click (the choice persisted).
After turning it off: localStorage holds 'denied' and the footer reads 'Google Analytics is off; nothing is sent.' again.
scenarios.data: none; the GA property id G-75YW6HE9FT is public

scenarios.title: A bogus ?agent= value and a blocked localStorage do not break the switcher
scenarios.actor: visitor arriving from a mangled link
steps: Open the entry URL and note which tab is selected and whether any dialog appeared.
Open http://localhost:4180/?agent=codex and note the selected tab; then open http://localhost:4180/ (no query) and note the selected tab.
Run in the page: Object.defineProperty(window, 'localStorage', { get() { throw new Error('blocked'); } }); then click the 'Git clone' tab and then the 'Any agent' tab.
Read the console for errors after each step.
expect: With the bogus value the first tab (Any agent) is selected and no dialog or script ran.
?agent=codex selects the Codex tab; the following plain visit shows the first tab, Any agent (nothing is stored between visits).
With localStorage throwing, clicking tabs still switches the panel and the console shows no uncaught error.
